newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh begins trial of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh begins trial of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

text.p: The trial of the alleged killers of Bangladesh's founding father Sheikh Mujibur Rahman began on Wednesday and was adjourned until March 24, Bangladesh court officials said.

The officials said the six accused of the August 1975 killing of Rahman, father of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, appeared before a makeshift court adjoining the central jail in the capital Dhaka. Security was tight.
They said Judge Kazi Golam Rasul set March 24 for outlining formal charges against the accused, which included four retired army officers, who have already been charged by police.
However, the officials said several others charged in the case had fled the country.
